articles.title: Gurgaon: Car follows woman biker, hits her bike and flees; incident caught on cam
articles.description: A woman biker claims a car repeatedly followed her on Sunday. The car allegedly hit her motorcycle and then fled the scene. Footage shared online shows the alleged collision and the car driving away. A friend pursued the car and confronted the driver at a traffic signal. The biker has appealed to Gurgaon Police for action and accountability.

articles.title: 'Everyone's been bugging me': Trump to remove 10% duty on Irish whiskey
articles.description: During the trophy presentation at the Irish Open, US President Donald Trump dropped a significant announcement: he plans to abolish the 10% tariff on Irish whiskey. This action responds to ongoing pleas from Irish Prime Minister Micheál Martin and the golfing community. The Distilled Spirits Council of the United States views this as a welcomed change that will positively impact businesses and consumers in the upcoming holiday period.

articles.description: A US Air Force officer survived nearly fifty hours in Iran after his jet was shot down. Over ninety American service members deployed for one of the most complex rescue operations. The officer, injured, hid in Iran's desert while Iranian forces searched for him. US forces used bombers and drones to strike Iranian Revolutionary Guard forces nearby. This mission demonstrated the US commitment to recovering its personnel.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Dead Boys guitarist Cheetah Chrome passes away at 71
articles.description: The punk rock world mourns the loss of Eugene Richard O'Connor, famously known as Cheetah Chrome, who has died at the age of seventy-one. The guitarist of the iconic band Dead Boys, Chrome played a pivotal role in shaping punk rock music. His career took off in 1974 with Rocket from the Tombs. He leaves behind his beloved wife and teenage son, who will honor his legacy.
